body:
This PR shows a path we looked into in order to make React InstantSearch work with Next.js 13 app router. The main goal was to go around the issue with `renderToString` not working in an RSC.

The idea was to duplicate the InstantSearch experience by having an InstantSearch.js representation of the app, with the same widgets as those used in React InstantSearch, so it can be run server-side and its initial results can be retrieved, to feed into the `InstantSearchSSRProvider`.

Apart from the obvious hurdle of having to write twice an implementation, there are some issues regarding where Next.js defines boundaries between server and client components.
title: poc: enable ssr with rsc
